$comment: P1-05 — editor.js WsEvent frame registry (UI consumer side of the ORM-02 event channel; spec plan/oo-port/wasm-events.md §4/§5, engine side core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm events.rs). One frame is one JSON object: {"event": "<snake_case WsEvent variant>", "payload": {...}|null} (serde tag=event/content=payload). editor.js dispatch contract: wsEventDispatcher(frame) fires a window 'wo-event' CustomEvent with detail {event, payload, at} for EVERY frame, plus a named 'wo-event:<event>' CustomEvent for the priority frames below; unknown frames (WsEvent::Other and the long tail) ride 'wo-event' only and survive 1:1. engineEventsSink(frame) is the no-op stub seam where the wasm set_event_sink callback attaches.

detail.payload: object|null — variant payload as specified by the engine enum

bus.malformed_frames: rejected (no dispatch): frame falsy or event not a non-empty string
bus.engine_seam: engineEventsSink(frame) — no-op stub until wired; the wasm glue calls wasm.set_event_sink((frame) => window.engineEventsSink(frame))
bus.guardrail: does not touch existing buses: wo-command, ctx-menu, wo:chart-settings, wo:print-selection, wo:keep-lines, odt-persisted, lists-persisted, images-persisted, wo-open-file

priority_frames.note: legacy zoom_change stays a distinct WsEvent variant engine-side
richest OO funnel (41 fire sites in the word bundle)
mirrors the existing ctx-menu CustomEvent path
disconnect banner; engine export asc_coAuthoringDisconnect emits it via events::push
